The '''''Emiax''''' was the personal [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] of [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. He took the shuttle with his [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|fleet]] of [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] during his [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to capture [[Abeloth]] in [[44 ABY]]. After the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] alliance with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was [[Duel at the Pool of Knowledge|broken]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] stole the ''Emiax'' and tracked Abeloth to [[Pydyr]].
